about: Parse speed, part 2: start and fixed costs: the T14 method again, with the target of T14 (its margin m). The speed of sqll and sqruff on the 28 start and 84 parse benchmarks, the noise, the phase times, the profile, the improvement classes of T14 and the new estimate, and the change from T14 ('change'). Each value is measured (the session and profile files), or derived or estimated with a formula of 'formulas'.
command: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3/speed_profile.py report --task T15

method.sessions: harness/bench.md (the S2 baseline method): the CI image in docker, a new container for each session, serial, no network, no other load; the full profile; the tools run in turn for each repeat (timer.run_in_turn). Session 1 is the controlled session; sessions 2 to 5 measure the noise. After the timed runs of session 1, each sqll input runs 5 times with --timings.
method.profile: valgrind callgrind: the instruction count (Ir) of one run of the symbol build on the input of each benchmark; for each phase of PROFILE_PHASES, one more run that collects only the cost of that function and its callees (--toggle-collect). The symbol build is the source of the sessions with debug line tables and no strip (CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=line-tables-only, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=none); its stdout and exit code are those of the release build on each input. Self cost: the instructions of the function itself, summed over its files and recursion levels. The cost classes (COST_CLASSES) group the self costs by function name. Inclusive cost: with the callees; a recursive function can have more than 100%. Limit: Ir is not time (a cache miss costs time, not instructions); the estimates use Ir shares as time shares.

formulas.ratio: R = T / S: T and S are the median wall times of sqll and sqruff on the benchmark in the controlled session (session 1).
formulas.spread: the spread of a benchmark: the largest R of the sessions divided by the smallest R of the sessions, minus 1.
formulas.margin: m = the margin of T14 (results/s3/speed-profile.json, target.margin). The target does not change after T14. 'noise' gives the spread of the sessions of this task, for information.
formulas.target: R < 1 / (1 + m) for each start and parse benchmark with a sqruff pair, in one controlled session. Then another controlled session gives R < 1 (G3.5), as far as the measured noise shows.
formulas.needed_factor: F = max(1, R * (1 + m)): T must become T / F or less.
formulas.phases: the median of each phase of the --timings runs of session 1 (seconds), and total, the sum of these medians.
formulas.outside_fixed: the time outside main of the dialect: T - total of the start benchmark of the same dialect, at least 0 (process start and exit, the loader, and the timer). The start benchmark has no other cost.
formulas.phase_time: the phases as parts of T: each phase * k, with k = (T - outside_fixed) / total. Thus the phases and outside_fixed add up to T. Reason: the --timings runs are not the timed runs (k is from 0.71 to 1.42).
formulas.removable: the cost that a class can remove (seconds), from the phase times and the Ir shares of the profile of the phase (classes).
formulas.gain: the gain of a class = r * removable. central: the r of the class; upper: r = 1 (all of the removable cost goes).
formulas.estimate: T_est = T - the sum of the gains; the reachable factor A = T / T_est (central and upper).
formulas.lex_parse_factor: the T6 formula speedup with the margin: k = LP / (S / (1 + m) - (T - LP)), LP = lex + parse of the phase times. With m = 0 it is the T6 formula. Unreachable if S / (1 + m) <= T - LP.
formulas.break_even_r: the largest, over the benchmarks with a sqruff pair, of the smallest r (the same r for each class with r < 1 in CLASSES) that gives A >= F. in_reach_central_no_margin: the benchmarks where the central A >= max(1, R), thus with m = 0.
formulas.go: go if the central A >= F for each start and parse benchmark with a sqruff pair; else no-go (status/S3.md, Stop rule).

change.formula: speedup = T of T14 / T now (the sqll medians of the 2 controlled sessions; another session and day, thus with noise)

classes.what: Exit with no drop of the parser, the tokens, the tree, and the record: the operating system frees the memory of the process.
classes.basis: measured phase free; the change removes all of it.

classes.what: Write the JSON from the parse tree, with no serde_yaml_ng Value record between them.
classes.basis: measured phases: the record phase goes. The new walk of the tree writes the same JSON (the cost of the write phase) and also walks the tree. An assumption: that walk of the tree costs as much as the write phase. Thus the gain is record - write, a low estimate (T15 measures it).

classes.what: Set up the lexer tables of the dialect at less cost: no clone of the matcher list, and only the regexes that the run uses.
classes.basis: measured phase setup; regex compile is the largest class of its profile. r = 0.5: an assumption (T15 measures it).

classes.what: Less work outside main: fewer relocations of the static tables (74k relocations of a position-independent binary), fewer page faults.
classes.basis: measured: outside_fixed, and the timer overhead (/bin/true) of the session. r = 0.5: an assumption.

classes.what: Less work from main to the file read (the command thread with a 256 MiB stack, the arguments, the file).
classes.basis: measured phase init. r = 0.5: an assumption.

classes.what: Fewer allocations, frees, drops, and copies in the parser: frames and match results by index or in an arena, with no move of large values and no clone of strings.
classes.removable: parse * (copy + allocator + drop shares of the parse profile)
classes.basis: the parse profile: memcpy, malloc and free, and drops. r = 0.5: an assumption (Ir is not time; a part of the work stays).

classes.what: A faster hash for the parse cache (SipHash now).
classes.removable: parse * hashing share of the parse profile
classes.basis: the parse profile. r = 0.5: an assumption.

classes.what: Fewer allocations, frees, drops, and copies in the lexer.
classes.removable: lex * (copy + allocator + drop shares of the lex profile)
classes.basis: the lex profile. r = 0.5: an assumption.

classes.what: Less regex work in the lexer: direct matchers for the frequent token types.
classes.removable: lex * regex share of the lex profile
classes.basis: the lex profile. r = 0.5: an assumption.

not_estimated: The own instructions of the parser (class parser of the parse profile) and changes of the parse algorithm have no estimate: no class gives them a gain.

go.reason: The central estimate reaches the needed factor F on 90 of 108 benchmarks; the upper bound (r = 1 for each class) on 108. Not in reach (central): 18 benchmarks, the largest F: parse/hive/large F 1.9248, A 1.4263, parse/ansi/large F 1.9234, A 1.4279, parse/db2/large F 1.9073, A 1.4254, parse/teradata/large F 1.7584, A 1.4226, parse/impala/large F 1.7111, A 1.4335. The human owner decided on 2026-11-01 that T15 and T16 run and that the checkpoint T16b decides (status/S3.md).
